[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Telegram scoring pipeline restored: empty-config post-mortem + diagnose URL coverage (PR #598)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/598
  
  Details:
  Diagnosed and fixed the silent outage of the Telegram chatlog scoring pipeline ("Scored Chatlogs" frozen at row 7224), then hardened the diagnostic that missed it.
  
  ROOT CAUSE (two stacked silent failures)
  - Three Script Properties were empty: TELEGRAM_SHEET_URL, OUTPUT_SHEET_URL, EXISTING_SHEET_URL.
  - processTelegramChatLogs() read TELEGRAM_SHEET_URL at module load and passed '' into SpreadsheetApp.openByUrl() on statement 2 — the 15-min trigger threw there on every tick for weeks.
  - logPipelineHealth_() was disabled by the SAME empty config (it early-returns when OUTPUT_SHEET_URL is unset), so the error reporter was dead alongside the pipeline. Trigger-side Logger.log was never watched.
  
  SECOND INSTANCE OF THE SAME CLASS
  - After the URLs were restored, scoring still failed: XAI_API_URL was also unset, throwing "Attribute provided with no value: url" at UrlFetchApp.fetch (grok_scoring_...js:681). Every row died on its first Grok call.
  - Also found unguarded-by-diagnose: OPENAI_API_URL (same gap; breaks the installed getClosestEquinoxOrSolstice trigger) and FILE_LOG_SHEET_URL (unset; breaks the installed processWhatsappChatlogs trigger).
  
  CODE CHANGE (PR #598)
  - Adds XAI_API_URL + OPENAI_API_URL to the required-Script-Property list.
  - Adds malformed-value validation so a *_URL that isn't http(s)-shaped now FAILS diagnose instead of passing.
  - Stops logPipelineHealth_ from returning silently when OUTPUT_SHEET_URL is unset.
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/tokenomics/pull/598
  
  VERIFICATION (evidence, not assertion)
  - Telegram!N12412 hash 08ACVGILMj/VNFTOQVRq == Scored Chatlogs!K7225 hash — byte-identical, proving the write path.
  - TDG math correct end-to-end: 60 min -> 100 TDG.
  - ?exec=diagnose returns ok:true, missing:[], all three sheets reachable.
  
  CORRECTIONS I OWE THE RECORD (three hypotheses of mine were wrong)
  - "The trigger was deleted" — FALSIFIED. The count:0 I cited was an authorization artifact (script.scriptapp missing from the anonymous /exec context). installScoringTrigger then reported removed:1, proving a trigger existed all along. The permission error is now documented in the Pipeline Health tab.
  - "~1500 Pending rows already carry col N hashes" — FALSIFIED. Actual pendingWithHash was 0; no row was ever partially processed.
  - My off-by-one attributing output row 7226 to source row 12412 — corrected: 7225<-12412, 7226<-12413.
  - Also corrected an over-confident "config healthy" verdict: diagnose checks 6 properties and does not yet include the API URLs until #598 lands.
  
  Amount is an estimate for source tracing, PR authorship, and multi-round verification.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 150.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
